name: Protopasta Carbon Fiber HTPETG @base
filament_notes:
High Strength (black, higher CF) and High Impact (galaxy black, lower CF) carbon-fiber HTPETG. ABS/ASA-level heat resistance without fumes.
Product page: nozzle up to 300C - higher temps improve layer adhesion but risk overheating when printing slow. Bed from 100C up prints flat. Consider flow below 100% and a nozzle-wipe-at-layer-change gcode to limit buildup; drying may not fully resolve nozzle stick.
Hardened nozzle and gears required (abrasive). Use Magigoo or glue stick.
